bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
root=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
test -d "$root" || exit 70
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 71
count=$(find "$root" -type f \( -iname '*.mp4' -o -iname '*.mkv' -o -iname '*.mov' -o -iname '*.webm' -o -iname '*.avi' \) | wc -l)
printf 'VIDEO_EXTENSION_COUNT=%s\n' "$count"
find "$root" -type f \( -iname '*783*' -o -iname '*.part' -o -iname '*.tmp' \) -printf 'MATCH=%p SIZE=%s\n' | head -25
printf 'ACTIVE_TARGET_UNITS\n'
grep -ril --include='*.service' 'theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV' "$HOME/.config/systemd/user" /etc/systemd/system 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do u=${f##*/}; printf '%s=%s\n' "$u" "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" 2>/dev/null || true)"; done
printf 'CHECKPOINT_FILES\n'
find "$root" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*.json' -o -iname '*.sqlite' -o -iname '*.db' \) -printf '%p %s\n' | head -20
exit 0
